_comment: One written line per picture on the DCC Reference tab: what the picture shows
and what is worth looking at in it. Read off the picture itself, in the notes'
voice - no deck talk, no 'this slide shows', no file names, one sentence. The
line becomes the picture's on-page note and its alt text, replacing the
'Illustration for 4.3.4 ...' that the slimming pass left behind in the alt.
tools/ref_slide_notes.py applies it, --check polices it, --restore inverts it.
A picture with no entry here is reported as pending rather than given filler.

notes.ch2/lecturemain-ch-2-communication-in-ds: The client blocks on a call that looks local and is not: the request travels to the server and the reply comes back, and everything the caller does not see is the two trips.
Count the ten steps between the client functions and the server functions - the call goes down both stubs and both kernels before any work happens, and the reply retraces the same ten in reverse.
notes.ch2/messagepassing-refnote2-p09.webp: Message queuing rather than message waiting: the sender writes into a queue it owns and returns, and the network carries the message across later - the channel attributes below list what that transfer has to decide.
notes.ch2/lecturemain-ch-2-communication-in-ds: What the three fault-tolerance measures buy: no retry and no duplicate filtering is only 'Maybe'; retrying without filtering re-executes for at-least-once; adding duplicate filtering gives at-most-once.
